title: validation.py's docstring says what the RULE 1 check checks today
intention: validation.py's docstring tells the next reader the rule that holds today.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienyoga9i at main: cairn/tools/base/validation.py lines 8-10 say 'Tools can import from any device (the device_isolation sieve checks only cairn/devices/<X>/ files ...). So the imports here are legal'. The RULE 1 check is build_inspector's encapsulation_holds, which since 124c0312c2d8 reds code outside every device reaching into one; device_isolation is deleted by 27f5ad6f62dc; and the module imports nothing from any device (67b78ae59c1d). The orchestrator asked for this one-liner.
traces_to: Law 5 (the thing and its story never contradict); Law 3.
how: D1: validation.py's docstring lines 8-10 say a tool may not import a device either, name encapsulation_holds and 124c0312c2d8, and keep 'callers in other devices import from this tool instead'. D2: new proof test_validation_says_what_rule_1_checks.py reads the docstring and the file's imports with ast.
